# SOVA - AI WhatsApp Sales & Automation Assistant

> SOVA is a premium AI-powered automation platform designed to transform WhatsApp from a chat app into a high-converting sales machine. It specializes in buyer intent detection, automated FAQ handling, and intelligent lead follow-ups for high-volume retailers and wholesalers.

## Core Value Proposition
SOVA acts as a 24/7 virtual sales team for WhatsApp-first businesses. It identifies serious buyers, handles repetitive product queries (price, size, stock), and re-engages leads automatically, allowing human teams to focus only on closing deals.

## Target Industries & Use Cases
SOVA is optimized for modern sellers with high chat volumes:
- **Clothing & Fashion**: Auto-replies for size charts, color variants, Cash on Delivery (COD) info, and delivery timelines.
- **Jewellery**: Instant catalog sharing, gold rate updates, and purity certification answers.
- **Dry Fruits & Groceries**: Seasonal demand management, per-kg pricing, and packaging automation.
- **Electronics & Hardware**: Specification sharing, stock availability, and technical support handoffs.
- **Wholesale & Toys**: Filtering bulk/reseller inquiries from casual retail browsing for faster routing.
- **Surgical & Medical Instruments**: Handling precision specs and bulk order certifications.

## Key Features
- **Serious Buyer Detection**: Uses AI to score chat intent and prioritize ready-to-buy customers.
- **24/7 Intelligent Auto-Replies**: Answers complex questions about products even when the team is offline.
- **Automated Smart Follow-Ups**: Re-engages customers who showed interest but didn't complete the purchase.
- **WhatsApp Broadcasts**: Send Meta-compliant updates, offers, and catalogs to entire customer lists.
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Deep insights into customer sentiment, trending items, and sales performance.
- **Multi-Language Support**: Optimized for English, Urdu (including Roman Urdu), Arabic, Hindi, Bengali, and German.

## Pricing & Plans
- **Basic ($18/mo)**: Best for small shops. 50 products, 1,000 AI replies, Roman Urdu support.
- **Pro ($43/mo)**: Best for busy retailers. 500 products, 5,000 AI replies, full analytics, sentiment analysis.
- **Enterprise (Custom)**: For wholesalers and industrialists. Unlimited products, custom integrations, and dedicated AI training.
- **Trial**: 30-day free access with no credit card required.

## Technical Setup
- **Connectivity**: Direct integration with the official WhatsApp Business API via Meta Business Account.
- **Setup Time**: Typically under 10 minutes with no technical coding skills required.
